case.consequence: v1 remains CURRENT, FROZEN and UNSENT
case.hash_authority: Mission 1.61's hash remains authoritative. Section 23 forbids computing a duplicate hash artifact for identical bytes, and none was computed.
case.why_not_CASE_B: CASE B requires at least one question to have become answered. None did.
case.why_not_CASE_C: CASE C requires no question to remain. Seven remain.

the_enquiry_is_not_evidence.statement: A drafted enquiry establishes nothing. It is a question, and it was not used as an input to any verdict in this mission.

why_the_reads_did_not_touch_the_enquiry.$comment: Worth stating, because four reads producing zero answered questions could look like the reads were wasted.
why_the_reads_did_not_touch_the_enquiry.explanation: Three of the four targets were ONYPHE questions, and the enquiry is addressed to the anchor. Only one target, the indices schema, mapped onto an enquiry question, and it did not resolve. The reads were not aimed at the enquiry; they were aimed at the two apparatuses' individual packages, and three of them moved evidence there.
why_the_reads_did_not_touch_the_enquiry.what_this_means_for_the_next_step: Six of the seven questions map onto load-bearing anchor A8 topics that no further public document has been found to address. That is the argument for contacting the provider rather than searching more.

contact_channel.$comment: Sections 24 and 25. A valid question and a valid recipient are two different facts.
contact_channel.what_the_page_carries: a printed instruction that questions or comments should be sent to an address, alongside the company's legal documents
contact_channel.why_the_address_is_not_recorded: It is served through an email-obfuscation mechanism, so tool retrieval returned a placeholder rather than the literal string. It was not resolved by Mission 1.62 and was not re-attempted here.
contact_channel.how_it_becomes_established: The operator opens that page in a browser, where the address renders, and supplies the exact displayed string. It is then recorded as first-party evidence.

next_action.recommended: the operator's decision on sending the frozen enquiry
next_action.why_this_rather_than_more_documentation_: Two missions have now spent bounded budgets on the anchor's operational questions. Mission 1.62 read the most likely remaining policy document and it closed none of them; Mission 1.63 pursued the last named lead and its schema is not published. The public route for these six questions is exhausted, which is exactly the condition an enquiry exists for.
next_action.what_approval_would_authorise: sending that text unchanged to a first-party channel the operator supplies, and nothing else
